QUOTE: No thread is spawned from `library/`. The four spawn sites the index found are all in `programs/`... The mutex is the wrapper from `threading.c`, which defaults to pthreads (`threading.c:103`) and can be replaced with `THREADING_ALT`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that no thread is created in `library/`. It also says `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex wrapper that modules use when threading is enabled.
